name: Meadows Metal Works LLC
old_description: At Meadows Metal Works, We specialize in high quality welding & custom fabrication services tailored to meet your specific needs. Whether you require MIG, TIG, or stick welding, our licensed, certified and insured professionals are equipped to handle Steel, Stainless steel, Aluminum, Titanium, Cast iron and Kirksite. From structural and precision welding to custom-made parts and repairs that other shops won't touch, we deliver reliable workmanship for both industrial and agricultural equipment. let us help you with everything, ensuring your projects are completed with precision and care.
about:
Meadows Metal Works LLC operates from Trenton, Michigan. The company does not publish a founding year, but its website notes over 15 years of experience in welding and fabrication. Ownership details and founder names are not disclosed.

The shop provides MIG, TIG, and stick welding along with structural and precision welding services. It works with steel, stainless steel, aluminum, titanium, cast iron, and kirksite, offering custom fabrication from one-off parts to modifications of existing equipment, as well as repair work for industrial and agricultural machinery. The company also handles custom-made parts and repairs that other shops decline.

Customers span industrial and agricultural equipment sectors, plus residential and commercial clients seeking welding and fabrication services. The company highlights its willingness to take on repairs that other shops turn away.

Meadows Metal Works emphasizes its licensed, certified, and insured professionals, a satisfaction guarantee on every project, a focus on safety and dependable service, and over 15 years of industry experience.
